data.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD2: When this story is complete, the sub-PR merge trailer grammar is coordinated with `verify-session-provenance.sh:137` so commits landing via a reviewed sub-PR are recognized as provenanced at session→main time. The chosen coordination is documented (read-side: extend `verify-session-provenance.sh` to accept BOTH `DSO-Story:` and `DSO-Story-Merge:` trailers).

## Implementation Notes

Modify `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` (existing test) to assert the BOTH-trailer-accepting behavior. Add new test cases:

Test approach (Given/When/Then):
- **Given**: a fixture commit body containing `DSO-Story: <story-id>` (single, no -Merge suffix)
- **When**: `verify-session-provenance.sh` is invoked over a range containing that commit
- **Then**: exit code 0 (commit is recognized as provenanced via the DSO-Story trailer)

- **Given**: a fixture commit body containing `DSO-Story-Merge: <story-id>` (with -Merge suffix)
- **When**: same invocation
- **Then**: exit code 0 (commit is recognized as provenanced via DSO-Story-Merge trailer — current behavior preserved)

The test should fail (RED) on the current `verify-session-provenance.sh:137` grep pattern `^DSO-Story-Merge:` because the first fixture (with `DSO-Story:` only) would not match.

Update `.test-index` with a `[test_verify_session_provenance_accepts_both_trailers]` RED marker for `plugins/dso/scripts/verify-session-provenance.sh`.

## File Impact

| Source file | Action | Associated tests | Test classification |
|-------------|--------|------------------|---------------------|
| `tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh` | modify | (this IS the test) | needs-modification |
| `.test-index` | modify | n/a | n/a (marker only) |

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] Test file modified with both-trailer assertion fixtures
  Verify: grep -q 'DSO-Story:' tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh && grep -q 'DSO-Story-Merge:' tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] Test is initially failing (RED) on the new DSO-Story-only fixture
  Verify: ! bash tests/scripts/test-verify-session-provenance.sh
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker for verify-session-provenance.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_verify_session_provenance_accepts_both_trailers\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
